headline: Jimmy Odukoya Addresses Leadership Dispute At Fountain Of Life Church
seoTitle: Jimmy Odukoya Disputes Fountain Of Life Church Removal
metaDescription: Jimmy Odukoya claims his late father warned him against trustees as the dispute over leadership at the Fountain of Life Church continues to intensify.
aiSummaryBullets: Jimmy Odukoya rejected his recent removal as senior pastor by the Board of Trustees at the Fountain of Life Church.
The board released a 2021 video of the church's founder discussing succession as part of their efforts to justify the leadership transition.
Odukoya stated that keeping his father's succession video was an error and claimed his father advised him against yielding to the trustees.
aiContextParagraph: The leadership conflict at the Fountain of Life Church reached a new phase as the Board of Trustees moved to remove Jimmy Odukoya from his position as senior pastor and appointed an interim leader. In response to these developments, Odukoya and segments of the church have formally rejected the board's decision, labeling the removal as invalid. The board attempted to support its stance by publicly releasing a 2021 video featuring the late founder, Taiwo Odukoya, addressing the topic of church succession. However, Jimmy Odukoya has since expressed regret over the handling of that recording and asserted that his late father contacted him in a dream to encourage him not to surrender to the trustees' demands. This unfolding situation has prompted widespread public reactions as the institution navigates this internal divide regarding its governance and executive authority.
whyItIsViral: The story is being widely reported by two independent news outlets, indicating a significant ongoing institutional dispute.
